result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few visual issues stand out: a horizontally cut-off restaurant card in 'Fastest near you', and a partially cut-off pizza card at the bottom edge of the screen.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') and delivery price partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel reveals a hint of the next card while keeping card content like names readable, or reduce card width / increase padding so the truncation is intentional (e.g., proper ellipsis) rather than appearing clipped.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is clipped by the bottom navigation bar, showing only a partial slice of content with no visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom padding/margins so the last card's content (title, rating, delivery info) is not obscured by the bottom tab bar, or add scroll insets below the nav bar.

issues.description: The category filter chips are cut off at the right edge (a chip is partially visible next to 'Healthy'), which is acceptable for a scrollable carousel but the partial chip may look unintentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or ensure at least a small portion of the next chip is visible to signal horizontal scrollability clearly.
